headline: This compact Glorious mechanical keyboard is just $35
summary: Get the Glorious GMMK 3 mechanical keyboard for only $34.99 at Woot. This 65-percent keyboard is a massive discount from its usual $139.99 price. Use coupon code WOOTGAMING at checkout to access the deal.

headline: Wordle meets Clippy in this new word game
summary: A new word game called 'Dartwords' combines the popular Wordle format with Clippy. Designed by Sam Rosenthal, creative director at The Game Band. It offers a fresh twist on daily word puzzles.

headline: YouTube is changing how it counts views to give the numbers a boost
summary: YouTube will soon count a view as soon as a video starts playing. This new system aligns with Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. The change takes effect August 24th, boosting creator view counts faster.

headline: The Analogue Pocket gets a Supreme makeover in red or gold
summary: Analogue and Supreme are collaborating on metallic Analogue Pocket handhelds. Special editions will be available in red and gold finishes. These exclusive consoles feature a Supreme logo and 24K Gold-plated options.

headline: The Bambu P1S Combo 3D Printer Drops to Its Lowest Price of the Year During Best Buy's Anniversary Sale
summary: The Bambu P1S Combo 3D Printer is at its lowest price during Best Buy's Anniversary Sale. This highly recommended 3D printer suits both novices and seasoned enthusiasts. It offers multi-color printing capabilities.

headline: Marvel Studios' Ghost Rider Sets July 2028 Release Date
summary: Marvel Studios has officially confirmed a release date for its Ghost Rider film. The highly anticipated movie is slated for July 2028. Fans can mark their calendars for the hero's cinematic return.

headline: Streamer Finally Gets Perfect Game in MVP Baseball 2005 After Nearly 2,000 Consecutive Attempts
summary: Streamer Jay Lucarelli achieved a perfect game in MVP Baseball 2005. It took him 1,993 attempts over a week-long streaming marathon. Lucarelli used former Astros pitcher Roy Oswalt for the incredible feat.

headline: The 10 Most Expensive Pokémon Cards of 2026 (So Far)
summary: Discover the top 10 most expensive Pokémon TCG cards of 2026. List includes high-value pulls like SIR Pikachu ex and SIR Mega Gengar ex. Stay updated on the evolving market for rare Pokémon collectibles.

headline: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
summary: Trump reportedly threatened to bomb US ally Oman. The threat relates to Oman's role in Iran deal negotiations. This comes as a 60-day peace negotiation window expires.

headline: Tributes to actress Hayden Panettiere as coroner finds 'no signs of trauma'
summary: Actress Hayden Panettiere has passed away at 36. Coroner found no signs of trauma in her death. Tributes pour in for the star of 'Heroes' and 'Nashville'.

headline: Fifa executive leaves job three weeks after speaking out against Infantino plan
summary: A senior FIFA executive has resigned from their position. This departure follows criticism of President Gianni Infantino's plans. The executive left just three weeks after speaking out.

headline: Burnham exchanged messages with person posing as Trump's chief of staff
summary: Burnham reportedly exchanged messages with an imposter. The individual posed as Donald Trump's chief of staff. Downing Street has declined to comment on the security breach.
